page.layout: One printed page: running head and page number at top; one text column at right; marginal notes in the left margin (three references: "a l. 1. & 2. de Imag.", "l. 2. c. 6."). A hand covers the lower part of the text block; the lower lines are partly hidden.

main_text.p: ab Apostolis in divinis litteris decernitur, sed neque decretum revera unquam fuisse patet; tum quod hoc Iudæos nunquam Apostolis objecisse, exprobrasseque legamus, quod (si verum esset) nemo dubitat, quin ante omnia velut capitale scelus, iis objecturi fuerint; tum quod id falsum sit, & cum divina lege diserte pugnet. Cum enim Dei lex, in qua cujusquam rei simulacrum fieri prohibetur, excepta ea parte, quæ cærimonialis & politica dicitur, tam Christianorum, quam Iudæorum sit, apparet, nisi (quod stultum est) fingatur, illud de simulacris præceptum ad cærimonialem legem pertinere, eandem omnino esse Christianorum, quæ Iudæorum est, rationem.

Tertio, idë quoq; validissime ex totius veteris Christianæ praxi, ac sententia demonstratur: quam quia proprio opere fuse exsecuti sumus, nihil necesse est hic pluribus explicare. In illa enim disputatione ostendimus nullas apud vetustissimos trium primorum sæculorum Christianos fuisse Christi & Sanctorum im-

page.notes: Lower portion of the column (from "dam ex vetustiss-" onward) is covered by a hand and a pink sleeve; those lines are only partly legible and are transcribed as far as visible. Some words at line ends are cut off by the hand and by the gutter; the printed text beneath the hand is not readable. Marginal reference marks are small and partly uncertain. Right-hand edge is show-through or shadow from the facing page and is omitted.
